scenario.name: 08-api-crashes
scenario.description: Two API instances; every 4 s one is SIGKILLed (rotating) and restarted 1 s later. 40 ms median processor latency keeps requests in flight at kill time. Clients rotate instances on retry.

environment.postgres: PostgreSQL 16.15 (Homebrew) on aarch64-apple-darwin25.6.0, compiled by Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.3.34.2), 64-bit
